sources.title: 2006–2007 annual report: director biography, printed page 5
sources.findings: Exchange-hosted 2006–2007 annual report, printed page 5: birth 11 December 1952; engineering degree from Madras; Sundaram-Clayton managing director from May 1979; TVS Motor managing director from 1986 and chairman from July 2002. Historical titles are not treated as all current.

sources.title: 14 January 2016: alumni and the Ever True campaign
sources.findings: Purdue explicitly identifies him as a 1977 management master’s alumnus. Prefer this to company shorthand MBA; do not turn later honorary doctorates into research degrees.

sources.publisher: Union of Japanese Scientists and Engineers
sources.title: 1 October 2019: Deming award recipients
sources.findings: JUSE announcement dated 1 October 2019 lists the distinct overseas dissemination and promotion service award. This is separate from company Deming awards and from the Deming Prize for Individuals category.

sources.title: 8 February 2022: chairman emeritus designation
sources.findings: February 2022 reporting establishes the effective date of 1 April 2022, with managing director retained. The earlier January 2023 succession plan was superseded. Official annual report search excerpt corroborated the date; full PDF fetch failed because of size.

sources.title: 16 February 2024: Venu Srinivasan v State of Tamil Nadu, 2024:MHC:1714
sources.findings: Read the High Court judgment, including operative paragraphs 73–74. It quashed the case against the petitioner in C.C.No.1 of 2023; this is not a criminal conviction or a finding that all later challenges ended.

sources.title: 14 October 2026: Supreme Court challenge to quashing order
sources.findings: Read October 14, 2026 court reporting. Allegations, denial and challenge to quashing are distinguished. Later listed hearing was not presumed to occur, and no final outcome after this report was established. Case-number details in the report are themselves unverified.

sources.title: 16 November 2026: family asset partition demand
sources.findings: Read November 16 PTI report about Lakshmi’s partition demand. A demand or asserted inheritance entitlement is not a court award, ownership finding or completed partition.

sources.title: Family succession: lessons from TVS
sources.findings: Read InGovern’s report to include Srinivasan’s opposing position that these were personal assets allocated fairly. InGovern explicitly does not adjudicate private family claims; company financial performance does not establish legal ownership.

sources.title: 14 November 2026: joint letter on Tata governance
sources.findings: Read November 14 reporting of the November 11 letter signed by Srinivasan and Vijay Singh. This supports recent activity; interpretations of Tata governance remain attributed positions, not judicial findings.

sources.title: Venu Srinivasan: board biography
sources.findings: Official board biography identifies chairman emeritus and quality-management work. Do not repeat its compressed attribution of the same 2002 Deming date to two different companies, or its inconsistent Korean award year/president pairing.

sources.title: 8 November 2021: notification 190, awards for 2020
sources.findings: Read the November 8, 2021 government gazette notification 190, naming him under Padma Bhushan for the award year 2020. Do not confuse the award year, notification date and media report date, or call this Padma Vibhushan.
